name: In-Hospital Complications Quality Indicator for Injury Admissions
description: A derived and validated quality indicator designed to benchmark hospital rates of in-hospital complications among injury admissions.
reputation: Established quality indicator used in health services research and hospital benchmarking for injury care, primarily within clinical and administrative data contexts.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark / health-quality indicator rather than benchmark for model comparison; susceptible to coding and administrative data biases, case-mix confounding, and institutional reporting variation.
